title: Boss: Order-Statistic Heist
mission: Steal the k-th most valuable treasure
briefing: The final chamber hides its treasures by value. Your contract names the k-th MOST valuable - that is the (n-k+1)-th smallest. Each room's badge shows its subtree size: use the sizes to descend straight to the target in O(log n) rooms. Between rounds the vault rebalances itself and you must confirm the new size labels.
hints: If the left subtree holds s rooms, the current room is the (s+1)-th smallest here.
Need a smaller position? Go left. Need position p > s+1? Go right and look for position p-s-1.
